project.description:
This use case explores the correlation relationship between illicit drug use in major European cities and their regional economic productivity (GDP). Normalized metabolite concentrations in wastewater are use to analyze regional deviations in GDP over the period of 2011-2024 in European countries.
Original Publishers: EUDA & SCORE, EUROSTAT.
EUDA & SCORE: URI: https://www.euda.europa.eu/data/repository/drugs-municipal-wastewater-europe-source-data-2026_en
EUROSTAT: DOI: https://doi.org/10.2908/NAMA_10R_3GDP, URI: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/nama_10r_3gdp__custom_20659344/default/table
